newsitem.title: MALTA: Arafat and Israel's Levy shake hands in Malta.
newsitem.headline: Arafat and Israel's Levy shake hands in Malta.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy shook hands in Malta on Tuesday at a reception given by the island's prime minister, witnesses said.

It was the highest level contact between Palestinians and Israelis since the peace process crumbled a month ago after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed ahead with building a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
The handshake took place on the fringes of a meeting of European Union and Mediterranean foreign ministers being held here, but it was still not clear if the two would sit down for more formal talks.
Arafat and Levy shook hands briefly as they waited to meet Maltese Prime Minister Alfred Sant and his Foreign Minister George Vella.
EU officials have been pressing for Arafat to meet Levy during the so-called Euro-Med conference, but so far Palestinians officials have said only that Planning Minister Nabil Shaath might meet Levy.
